FeaturesPage.title: What ClipsX can do
FeaturesPage.subtitle: Built for power users who live in the clipboard.
FeaturesPage.search_body: Powered by local embeddings, ClipsX finds clips by meaning. Type "email about Tokyo project" and get it, even if you never typed those exact words.
FeaturesPage.ocr_body: Paste a screenshot of a table and ClipsX will automatically OCR it, making the text searchable and paste-able as structured data.
FeaturesPage.detect_body: Every clip is analyzed: URL, code snippet, JSON, JWT, CSV, color hex, file path. Detected types unlock context-aware previews and actions.
FeaturesPage.local_body: All data lives in SQLite on your device. Semantic vectors are computed locally. No internet connection required for any core feature.
FeaturesPage.history_body: Never lose a clip again. ClipsX stores your full clipboard history with fast full-text search alongside semantic search.
FeaturesPage.tags_body: Label and annotate clips. Organize by project, client, or workflow. Tags and notes are full-text searchable.
FeaturesPage.updater_body: Stay current automatically. ClipsX checks for updates in the background and applies them with a single click.
FeaturesPage.keyboard_body: Launch, search, and paste entirely from the keyboard. Designed for users who rarely touch the mouse.

FaqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ClipsX.
FaqPage.a1: Yes. ClipsX stores all clipboard data in a local SQLite database on your device. Semantic embeddings are computed locally. Nothing is sent to a server unless you explicitly connect a cloud AI provider.
FaqPage.a2: macOS (12+), Windows 10 (64-bit), and Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+, Fedora 35+, AppImage). ARM and x64 are both supported on macOS.
FaqPage.q3: How is semantic search different from regular search?
FaqPage.a3: Full-text search matches keywords. Semantic search matches meaning. If you copied a Python snippet labeled "quick sort" and search for "sorting algorithm", semantic search will surface it. Regular search won't.
FaqPage.a4: ClipsX respects password manager exclusions on macOS and has an optional blocklist for specific apps. By default it captures all clipboard changes.
FaqPage.q5: Can I use ClipsX without a paid plan?
FaqPage.a5: Yes. ClipsX Free includes unlimited clipboard history, full-text search, tags, and notes — forever. Pro and Team plans unlock semantic search, OCR, and content detection.
FaqPage.a6: Annual plans have a 14-day refund window. Monthly plans cancel at end of period with no refund.
